info.name: UniPathway API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the UniPathway backend (Assignment 2).

Base URL: http://localhost:3000
All routes are under the /api prefix.

Authentication is simulated via headers:
- x-user-role: admin | editor | user
- x-user-id: <userId> (required for self-access routes)

Organized by resource. Each folder contains happy-path requests and at least one error example.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login and registration endpoints. No role headers required - these are public.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management. GET is open to all roles. POST/DELETE require admin. PUT allows self-update via x-user-id.

request.description: Lists all administrator accounts via the Admin ORM model (Users JOIN Settings, scoped to userRole='admin').
Non-admin roles may not list administrators.

item.name: Settings
item.description: User settings (email, password, theme, username). Identified by x-user-id. Admin can access any user's settings via /api/settings/:id.

item.name: Universities
item.description: GET is public. POST/PUT require admin or editor. DELETE requires admin.
